BRIARHOLD

"briar" is the Castle of Briarhold itself: its shape stays, its rooms and dangers change each night. Any other seed raises its own castle.

Left thumbdrag anywhere to move Right thumbdrag to look · or tap the screen to attack ATTACKswing or cast · hold to charge a power attack DASHdodge through attacks · dodge at the last moment for a perfect dodge USEpick up, open doors and chests (glows when something's in reach) Hotbartap a slot to hold it · tap again to drink or eat BAG / MAP / IIinventory · full map · pause  ·  play in landscape

JOURNAL

The game saves itself every few seconds and whenever you leave, so you can stop at any moment and carry on exactly where you were. Dying ends the run.

YOUR SHADE

IT HAS

GIVE IT

Give it a weapon to wield, armour to wear, or anything to carry. If it falls, everything it has drops where it stood.

THE REFORGING ANVIL

One reforge stone remakes one weapon or piece of armour: a new quality, often a new enchantment; new toughness and a new bonus. Legendary weapons can't be reforged.

PLAY TOGETHER

HOST A GAME

Your world is the one everyone plays in. You get an invite code for each friend.

JOIN A GAME

Type the 8-character code your host sent you.
Send this reply code back to your host. You are in as soon as they paste it.
Relay server (if the games can't connect directly)
A free public relay is already tried. If that isn't enough, make a free TURN account (for example at metered.ca) and enter it here, on at least one of the devices. The relay only passes the encrypted traffic along.
Or join a room by name
Up to four players. A public matchmaking server only introduces the games; then they connect straight to each other, encrypted. Others play in the host's world with their own character, and take home what they found when they leave.
